note.en: Only better than a 635+ base ATK Light Cone from any Path at S3+. If wanting to buff the selected DPS with ATK, use a high base ATK Light Cone from any Path instead of [[light-cone:journey-forever-peaceful]].

Majority of Preservation Light Cones do not have a high base ATK, therefore using any high base ATK Light Cone from any Path works better. Prioritize 635+ base ATK Light Cones, ex. Acheron S1 - [[light-cone:along-the-passing-shore]]. If lacking 635+ base ATK light cones, use any 582+ base ATK Light Cone from any Path, ex. Himeko's signature Light Cone, [[light-cone:milky-way]].
Can be used with DoT team. Build to 75% [[stat:ehr]] to receive a 100% ATK buff from Kafka's A2 Trace: Torture.
